context:
Goal: PR 238 (restyle step 8) lands with every contrast audit passing on the phone.
Problem (rule): the Find pill floats over the list and covers row text, so the contrast audit fails on "Test Set · Near Mint" (frame 73,723,102,14) and, in 12 tests, on the editor Save button and the stepper plus button, and only your word can change the pill's place or skip the audit on its frame.
Based on (measured): the phone UI run 43848366093 on the latest commit of PR 238, read test by test by lane restyle-step8.
Based on (measured): the screen check on the latest commit of PR 238, an 18 Pro at 402x874pt, read from the pictures by lane restyle-step8: the pill top is 731pt and the list ends at 723pt at rest.
Based on (read): the designer's spec for the band, kept with the lane's notes.
Departs from: FindPill.swift:3, where the pill floats over the list on the phone — option a ends the phone list above the pill with a paper band and a 1pt rule, so 8pt of list goes at rest. The list ends at 723, 723 and 715.3pt at normal size, M and AX5, which is 3 to 4pt more list than the mockup promised (719, 720 and 712pt). 0 whole Tally rows are lost at normal size and M (5 rows show whole, the 6th is cut). Whether 8pt would finish the cut Packages card line is unmeasured. At the two largest text sizes (AX3, AX5) the list shows zero rows at rest on Packages and Tally, so the band costs 0 rows there, and the tall masthead causes it (a later lane). The web keeps its floating pill.
Verdicts against the mockup: normal size and M pass on Packages and Tally. AX3 and AX5 fail on both, from the masthead.
Unmeasured: the sort grid at the large text sizes, empty states, the Tally error bar, dark theme, and the folded Duo.
Meanwhile: the lane builds option a and keeps PR 238 a draft, and nothing merges before your word.

options.gain: Every contrast audit passes with no skip, and no row text sits under the pill.
options.how: On the phone, the list ends above the Find pill. A paper band with a 1pt rule sits under the last row, so the pill no longer floats over rows. No audit skip is added.
options.label: End the list above the pill with a paper band

links.label: Picture: the list ends above the pill, paper band under it

options.lose: 8pt of list goes at rest, with 0 whole Tally rows lost at normal size and M. The two largest text sizes already show zero rows, from the tall masthead. It also changes the phone's bottom-bar ruling.

options.gain: No change to how the list looks, and no list is lost.
options.how: The pill keeps floating over the list. The phone audit skips the contrast check on the pill's frame, named, and every other check stays on. Decision audit-skips-measured-flags allows only skips you name, so this is a new named skip that only your answer can add.

links.label: Picture: the pill floats over the list

options.lose: The audit stops checking contrast under the pill, so row text under it can go unread, and the red tests stay unfixed apart from the skip.

Option b has a picture in the page, "Pill Floats Over List" (today's look, the pill over the list), but the page shows it as a View button with only a sliver of picture, which is the same fault you showed on item 62. title: The phone's Find pill floats over the list and fails the contrast audit. End the list above the pill, or skip the audit on it?
why: A band fixes the cause, a pill that covers text, with no new blind spot in the audit, and it costs only about 8pt of rows.
